mapper.select: SELECT result_payload FROM evacuation_route_store WHERE layout_version_id = #{layoutVersionId} ORDER BY computed_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO evacuation_route_store (cache_key, layout_id, layout_version_id, result_payload) VALUES (#{cacheKey}, #{layoutId}, #{layoutVersionId}, #{resultPayload}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE layout_id = VALUES(layout_id), layout_version_id = VALUES(layout_version_id), result_payload = VALUES(result_payload), computed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
